name: Angel Of The Churches
overview: The title 'Angel of the Churches' in Revelation refers to a representative figure associated with each of the seven churches addressed in chapters 2 and 3. These angels are symbolized as the seven stars held in Christ's right hand, indicating His sovereign authority over them (Revelation 1:20). Each letter begins with a direct message to the angel of a specific church, emphasizing Christ’s intimate knowledge and control over the churches, as He identifies Himself with titles reflecting His divine attributes and authority (Revelation 2:1, 2:8, 2:12, 2:18, 3:1). This highlights the personal and spiritual oversight Christ exercises over His church through these angelic messengers.
